```{r}
ids <- demographics |>

```

### AUH - Alcohol Use History

- How old were you when you first believed that you had a drinking problem?

- What types of programs or services have you used in the past to help you quit drinking? Please select all that apply.

- Have you ever taken prescribed medication to help maintain abstinence from alcohol?

- What was the most recent date that you quit drinking alcohol? Please indicate the date after your last drink. (can drop, low variance)

- In the six months prior to your most recent quit date, on average how many days per week did you consume 6 or more alcoholic drinks in one day? (drop)

- In the six months when you drank at your heaviest in your life,  on average how many days per week did you consume 6 or more alcoholic drinks in one day? (drop)

COCO: simplify for treatment program (e.g., outpatient vs. inpatient); can consider drop medication

```{r}
ids <- screen |>
  select(subid, starts_with("auh_"), -starts_with("auh_7"), -starts_with("auh_8")) |>
  rename(auh_onset_drink = auh_1, auh_onset_heavy = auh_2, 
         auh_onset_prob = auh_3, auh_quit_age = auh_4, auh_quit_attempts = auh_5,
         auh_recent_freq = auh_9, auh_recent_severity = auh_10,
         auh_recent_quant = auh_11, auh_heavy_freq = auh_12,
         auh_heavy_severity = auh_13, auh_heavy_quant = auh_14) |>
  mutate(
    across(auh_6_1:auh_6_7,
    ~ if_else(is.na(.x), "No", "Yes")),
    auh_service = if_else(if_any(auh_6_1:auh_6_6, ~ . == "Yes"), "Yes", "No")
  ) |>
  select(-starts_with("auh_6")) |> 
  right_join(ids, by = "subid") |>
  relocate(subid, starts_with("demo")) |>
  glimpse()
```

### DSM5

```{r}
ids <- screen |> 
  select(subid, starts_with("dsm5")) |> 
  mutate(dsm5_total = rowSums(across(starts_with("dsm5"), ~ .x == "Yes"), 
                              na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  select(subid, dsm5_total) |> 
  right_join(ids, by = "subid") |>
  relocate(-dsm5_total) |> 
  glimpse()
```

### YAP (Young Adult Alcohol Problems Screening Test)

past year vs. lifetime

chose lifetime

```{r}
screen |> 
  select(subid, starts_with("yap")) |> 
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("yap"),
           ~ if_else(.x == "No, never", "No", "Yes"))
  ) |> 
  skimr::skim()
  
ids <- screen |> 
  select(subid, starts_with("yap")) |>
  mutate(yap = rowSums(across(starts_with("yap"), ~ .x != "No, never"),
                        na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  select(subid, yap) |> 
  right_join(ids, by = "subid") |> 
  relocate(-yap) |> 
  glimpse()
```

### SCL-90

SUBSCALES: somatization, obsessive-compulsive, interpersonal sensitivity, depression,
anxiety, anger-hostility, phobic anxiety, paranoid ideation, psychoticism

```{r}
ids <- screen |> 
  select(subid, starts_with("scl90")) |> 
  mutate(
    across(
      starts_with("scl90"),
      ~ as.numeric(factor(.x, ordered = TRUE,
                          levels = c("Not At All", "A Little Bit", "Moderately", 
                                     "Quite A Bit", "Extremely")))
    ),
    scl90 = var_score(pick(starts_with("scl90")), 
                      forward_items = names(pick(starts_with("scl90"))))
  ) |> 
  select(subid, scl90) |> 
  right_join(ids, by = "subid") |> 
  relocate(-scl90) |> 
  glimpse()
```

### MPS

**positive emotionality**

dS$MPS_PEM = round((dS$MPS_WB * 1.933) + (dS$MPS_SP * 1.669) + (dS$MPS_AC * 1.671) + (dS$MPS_SC * 1.950) + (dS$MPS_SR * 0.085) + (dS$MPS_AL * 0.292) + (dS$MPS_AG * 0.130) + (dS$MPS_CT * 0.048) + (dS$MPS_HA * 0.015) + (dS$MPS_TD * 0.070) + 13.712 )

**negative emotionality**

dS$MPS_NEM = round((dS$MPS_WB * 0.127) + (dS$MPS_SP * 0.150) + (dS$MPS_AC * 0.038) + (dS$MPS_SC * 0.279) + (dS$MPS_SR * 1.904) + (dS$MPS_AL * 3.061) + (dS$MPS_AG * 2.551) + (dS$MPS_CT * 0.045) + (dS$MPS_HA * 0.126) + (dS$MPS_TD * 0.147) + 6.270 )

**constraint**

dS$MPS_CON = round((dS$MPS_WB * -0.085) + (dS$MPS_SP * -0.052) + (dS$MPS_AC * 0.241) + (dS$MPS_SC * -0.068) + (dS$MPS_SR * 0.046) + (dS$MPS_AL * -0.302) + (dS$MPS_AG* 0.296) + (dS$MPS_CT * 2.717) + (dS$MPS_HA * 2.579) + (dS$MPS_TD * 2.199) + 20.742 )


```{r}
mps_wellbeing_forward <- c("mps_1", "mps_26", "mps_38", "mps_50", "mps_62",

mps_achievement_forward <- c("mps_3", "mps_16", "mps_27", "mps_52", "mps_76",  
                             "mps_88", "mps_111", "mps_123","mps_135","mps_146")

mps_social_closeness_forward <- c("mps_5", "mps_40", "mps_77", "mps_112")
mps_social_closeness_reverse <- c("mps_17", "mps_28", "mps_65", "mps_89", "mps_136", "mps_100",
                          "mps_148", "mps_124")

mps_stress_reaction_forward <- c("mps_6", "mps_18", "mps_29", "mps_41", "mps_53",  
                                 "mps_78", "mps_90", "mps_101", "mps_113","mps_125", 
                                 "mps_137","mps_149")

                            "mps_66", "mps_91", "mps_102","mps_114", "mps_126", 
                            "mps_138","mps_150")
mps_alienation_reverse <- NULL

mps_aggression_forward <- c("mps_8", "mps_20", "mps_31", "mps_43", "mps_55",  
                            "mps_67", "mps_103", "mps_115","mps_127","mps_139", 
                            "mps_151")
mps_aggression_reverse <- c("mps_79")

mps_harm_avoidance_reverse <- c("mps_11", "mps_22", "mps_34", "mps_46", "mps_69",

                                "mps_94", "mps_106","mps_142","mps_154")
mps_traditionalism_reverse <- c("mps_47", "mps_70", "mps_118")


mps_absorption_forward <- c("mps_13", "mps_24", "mps_36", "mps_48", "mps_59",  "mps_71", 
                    "mps_83", "mps_95", "mps_107","mps_119",  "mps_130","mps_155")
mps_absorption_reverse <- NULL

# mps_unlikely_virtues_forward <- c("mps_25", "mps_49", "mps_72", "mps_96", "mps_120", "mps_143", "mps_147")
# mps_unlikely_virtues_reverse <- c("mps_4", "mps_14", "mps_37", "mps_61", "mps_84",
#                                   "mps_108", "mps_131")

ids <- screen |> 
  select(subid, starts_with("mps")) |> 
  mutate(
    mps_17 = if_else(mps_17 == "I tend to seek the company of a friend.", FALSE, TRUE),
    mps_34 = if_else(mps_34 == "Having a pilot announce that the plane has engine trouble and it may be necessary to make an emergency landing.",
                     FALSE, TRUE),
    mps_57 = if_else(mps_57 == "Having to walk around all day on a blistered foot,",
                     FALSE, TRUE),
    mps_69 = if_else(mps_69 == "Being out on a sailboat during a great storm at sea,",
                     FALSE, TRUE),
    mps_70 = if_else(mps_70 == "Stricter observance of major religious holidays",
                     FALSE, TRUE),
    mps_81 = if_else(mps_81 == "Being at the circus when two lions suddenly get loose down in the ring,",
                     FALSE, TRUE),
    mps_93 = if_else(mps_93 == "Riding a long stretch of rapids in a canoe,",
                     FALSE, TRUE),
    mps_105 = if_else(mps_105 == "Being sick to my stomach for 24 hours.",
                      TRUE, FALSE),
    mps_129 = if_else(mps_129 == "Being in a flood", FALSE, TRUE),
    mps_141 = if_else(mps_141 == "Being seasick every day for a week while on an ocean voyage",
                      FALSE, TRUE),
    across(starts_with("mps"), ~ if_else(.x == TRUE, 1, 0))
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    mps_wb = var_score(pick(all_of(starts_with("mps_"))), 
                              forward_items = mps_wellbeing_forward,
                              reverse_items = mps_wellbeing_reverse,
                              item_range = c(0, 1)),
    mps_sp = var_score(pick(all_of(starts_with("mps_"))),
                                   forward_items = mps_social_potency_forward,
                                   reverse_items = mps_social_potency_reverse,
                                   item_range = c(0, 1)),
    mps_ac = var_score(pick(all_of(starts_with("mps_"))),
                                 forward_items = mps_achievement_forward,
                                 reverse_items = mps_achievement_reverse,
                                 item_range = c(0, 1)),
    mps_sc = var_score(pick(all_of(starts_with("mps_"))),
                                      forward_items = mps_social_closeness_forward,
                                      reverse_items = mps_social_closeness_reverse,
                                      item_range = c(0, 1)),
    mps_sr = var_score(pick(all_of(starts_with("mps_"))),
                                     forward_items = mps_stress_reaction_forward,
                                      reverse_items = mps_stress_reaction_reverse,
                                      item_range = c(0, 1)),
    mps_al = var_score(pick(all_of(starts_with("mps_"))),
                               forward_items = mps_alienation_forward,
                                      reverse_items = mps_alienation_reverse,
                                      item_range = c(0, 1)),
    mps_ag = var_score(pick(all_of(starts_with("mps_"))),
                                 forward_items = mps_aggression_forward,
                                      reverse_items = mps_aggression_reverse,
                                      item_range = c(0, 1)),
    mps_ct = var_score(pick(all_of(starts_with("mps_"))),
                                 forward_items = mps_control_forward,
                                      reverse_items = mps_control_reverse,
                                      item_range = c(0, 1)),
    mps_ha = var_score(pick(all_of(starts_with("mps_"))),
                                 forward_items = mps_harm_avoidance_forward,
                                      reverse_items = mps_harm_avoidance_reverse,
                                      item_range = c(0, 1)),
    mps_td = var_score(pick(all_of(starts_with("mps_"))),
                                 forward_items = mps_traditionalism_forward,
                                      reverse_items = mps_traditionalism_reverse,
                                      item_range = c(0, 1)),
    mps_ab = var_score(pick(all_of(starts_with("mps_"))),
                                 forward_items = mps_absorption_forward,
                                      reverse_items = mps_absorption_reverse,
                                      item_range = c(0, 1)),
    mps_pem = round((mps_wb * 1.933) + (mps_sp * 1.669) + (mps_ac * 1.671) + 
                      (mps_sc * 1.950) + (mps_sr * 0.085) + (mps_al * 0.292) + 
                      (mps_ag * 0.130) + (mps_ct * 0.048) + (mps_ha * 0.015) + 
                      (mps_td * 0.070) + 13.712),
    mps_nem = round((mps_wb * 0.127) + (mps_sp * 0.150) + (mps_ac * 0.038) + 
                      (mps_sc * 0.279) + (mps_sr * 1.904) + (mps_al * 3.061) + 
                      (mps_ag * 2.551) + (mps_ct * 0.045) + (mps_ha * 0.126) + 
                      (mps_td * 0.147) + 6.270),
    mps_con = round((mps_wb * -0.085) + (mps_sp * -0.052) + (mps_ac * 0.241) + 
                      (mps_sc * -0.068) + (mps_sr * 0.046) + (mps_al * -0.302) + 
                      (mps_ag * 0.296) + (mps_ct * 2.717) + (mps_ha * 2.579) + 
                      (mps_td * 2.199) + 20.742)
    
  ) |> 
  select(-matches("^mps_\\d+$")) |> 
  right_join(ids, by = "subid") |> 
  relocate(-starts_with("mps")) |> 
  glimpse()
```

### PACS - Penn Alcohol Craving Scale

```{r}
ids <- intake |> 
  select(subid, starts_with("pacs")) |> 
  mutate(
    pacs_1 = as.numeric(
      factor(pacs_1, ordered = TRUE,
             levels = c(
               "Never - 0 times during this period of time",
               "Rarely - 1 to 2 times during this period of time",
               "Occasionally - 3 to 4 times during this period of time",
               "Sometimes - 5 to 10 times during this period of time",
               "Often - 11 to 20 times during this period of time",
               "Most of the time - 20 to 40 times during this period of time",
               "Nearly all of the time - more than 40 times or more than 6 times per day"
               ))
    ),
    pacs_2 = as.numeric(
      factor(pacs_2, ordered = TRUE,
             levels = c(
               "None at all",
               "Slight, that is a very mild urge",
               "Mild urge",
               "Moderate urge",
               "Strong urge, but easily controlled",
               "Strong urge and difficult to control",
               "Strong urge and would have drunk alcohol if it were available"
               ))
    ),
    pacs_3 = as.numeric(
      factor(pacs_3, ordered = TRUE,
             levels = c(
               "None at all",
               "Less than 20 minutes",
               "21-45 minutes",
               "46-90 minutes",
               "90 minutes-3 hours",
               "Between 3 and 6 hours",
               "More than 6 hours"
             ))
    ),
    pacs_4 = as.numeric(
      factor(pacs_4, ordered = TRUE,
             levels = c(
               "Not difficult at all",
               "Very mildly difficult",
               "Mildly difficult",
               "Moderately difficult",
               "Very difficult",
               "Extremely difficult",
               "Would not be able to resist"
             ))
    ),
    pacs_5 = as.numeric(
      factor(pacs_5, ordered = TRUE,
             levels = c(
               "Never thought about drinking and never had the urge to drink",
               "Rarely thought about drinking and rarely had the urge to drink",
               "Occasionally thought about drinking and occasionally had the urge to drink",
               "Sometimes thought about drinking and sometimes had the urge to drink",
               "Often thought about drinking and often had the urge to drink",
               "Thought about drinking most of the time and had the urge to drink most of the time",
               "Thought about drinking nearly all of the time and had the urge to drink nearly all of the time"
             ))
    ),
    pacs = var_score(pick(starts_with("pacs")),
                    forward_items = names(pick(starts_with("pacs"))))
  ) |>
  select(subid, pacs) |> 
  right_join(ids, by = "subid") |> 
  relocate(-pacs) |> 
  glimpse()
```

### AASE - Alcohol Abstinence Self-Efficacy Scale

```{r}
ids <- intake |> 
  select(subid, starts_with("aase")) |> 
  mutate(
    across(
      starts_with("aase"),
      ~ as.numeric(
        factor(.x, ordered = TRUE,
               levels = c(
                 "Not at all", 
                 "Not very",
                 "Moderately",
                 "Very",
                 "Extremely"
               ))
      )
    ),
    aase_total = var_score(pick(starts_with("aase")),
                           forward_items = names(pick(starts_with("aase")))),
    aase_neg_affect = var_score(pick(starts_with("aase")), forward_items = 
                                  c("aase_18", "aase_16", "aase_3", 
                                    "aase_14", "aase_6")),
    aase_social = var_score(pick(starts_with("aase")), forward_items =
                              c("aase_15", "aase_20", "aase_4", 
                                "aase_17", "aase_8")),
    aase_physical = var_score(pick(starts_with("aase")), forward_items =
                                c("aase_2", "aase_12", "aase_5", 
                                  "aase_13", "aase_9")),
    aase_craving = var_score(pick(starts_with("aase")), forward_items =
                               c("aase_1", "aase_7", "aase_11", 
                                 "aase_10", "aase_19")),
  ) |> 
  select(subid, "aase_total", "aase_neg_affect", "aase_social",
         "aase_physical", "aase_craving") |> 
  right_join(ids, by = "subid") |> 
  relocate(-c("aase_total", "aase_neg_affect", "aase_social",
              "aase_physical", "aase_craving")) |> 
  glimpse()

```

### DASS - Depression Anxiety Stress Scale

COCO: check if total score was used before
scl90 vs. dass

```{r}
ids <- intake |> 
  select(subid, starts_with("dass")) |> 
  mutate(
    across(
      starts_with("dass21"),
      ~ as.numeric(
        factor(.x, ordered = TRUE,
               levels = c("Never", "Sometimes", "Often", "Almost Always"))
      )
    ),
    dass_total = var_score(pick(starts_with("dass21")),
                           forward_items = names(pick(starts_with("dass21")))),
    dass_anx = var_score(pick(starts_with("dass21")),
                         forward_items = c("dass21_2", "dass21_4", "dass21_7",
                                           "dass21_9", "dass21_15", "dass21_19",
                                           "dass21_20")),
    dass_dep = var_score(pick(starts_with("dass21")),
                         forward_items = c("dass21_3", "dass21_5", "dass21_10",
                                           "dass21_13", "dass21_16", "dass21_17",
                                           "dass21_21")),
    dass_stress = var_score(pick(starts_with("dass21")),
                            forward_items = c("dass21_1", "dass21_6", "dass21_8",
                                              "dass21_11", "dass21_12", "dass21_14",
                                              "dass21_18"))
  ) |> 
  select(subid, dass_total, dass_anx, dass_dep, dass_stress) |> 
  right_join(ids, by = "subid") |> 
  relocate(-c("dass_total", "dass_anx", "dass_dep", "dass_stress")) |> 
  glimpse()
```

### MSPSS - Multidimensional Scale of Perceived Social Support

```{r}
ids <- intake |> 
  select(subid, starts_with("mspss")) |> 
  mutate(
    across(
      starts_with("mspss"),
      ~ as.numeric(
        factor(.x, ordered = TRUE,
               levels = c("Very Strongly Disagree", "Strongly Disagree",
                          "Mildly Disagree", "Neutral", "Mildly Agree",
                          "Strongly Agree", "Very Strongly Agree"))
      )
    ),
    mspss = var_score(pick(starts_with("mspss")),
                      forward_items = names(pick(starts_with("mspss"))))
  ) |> 
  select(subid, mspss) |> 
  right_join(ids, by = "subid") |> 
  relocate(-mspss) |> 
  glimpse()
```
